title: Xadgudubka Xeebta
intro: Waxaad taagan tahay ciidda xeeb la ilaaway, halkaas oo hirarku ay ku hoos jiraan bulsho lagu tijaabiyay amar rabbaani ah. Hawada ayaa culus iyadoo xasuusanaysa xadgudub horseeday isbeddel naxdin leh. Yaa ahaayeen nafahan, maxayse ahaayeen dabeecadda maxkamadayntoodu?
clues: Waxaan ahayn bulsho amar cad ka heshay Rabbigeen, haddana waxaan helnay siyaabo aan uga hor imaan karno.
Waxaan ku noolayn meel u dhow biyo, nolosheennuna waxay ku tiirsanayd makhluuqaadka.
Imtixaan ayaa nagu soo dhacay maalintii nala faray inaan ka fogaano raadinta adduunyada.
Xayawaanka biyaha ayaa maalintaas noo yimid iyagoo aad u tiro badan, iyagoo na jirrabaya si aan dulqaad lahayn.
Waxaan diyaarinay xeelad xeeladaysan si aan uga gudubno nidaamka rabbaaniga ah, annagoo u maleynayna inaan ka adkaan karno amarka.
Xadgudubkeennii wuxuu horseeday isbeddel ceeb ah; waxaan noqonnay daanyeer la quudhsado amarka Alle.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱعْتَدَوْا۟ مِنكُمْ فِى ٱلسَّبْتِ فَقُلْنَا لَهُمْ كُونُوا۟ قِرَدَةً خَـٰسِـِٔينَ
verse: And you had already known about those who transgressed among you concerning the sabbath, and We said to them, "Be apes, despised." (2:65)
